nodes.label: Email/Password Sessions
nodes.rationale: Email/password enabled with min password length 8; session 7d expiry and 1d update age; do not invent a parallel auth system—extend Better Auth plugins/config.

nodes.label: Text Primary Keys
nodes.rationale: Text primary keys (Better Auth style), not serials; Better Auth tables keep camelCase column names to match the adapter.

nodes.label: Thin Route Handlers
nodes.rationale: Map CCXT tickers/orders to app types in the service layer—keep route handlers thin; UI form state in Zustand, server data via TanStack Query/route handlers.

nodes.label: Skill Quality Verification
nodes.rationale: Do not recommend solely from search; prefer 1K+ installs, official sources, and repos with sufficient stars.

nodes.label: Server-Only CCXT
nodes.rationale: CCXT calls run only on the server—keys never reach the client; all /api/exchange/* routes require authentication.
